headline: Rest Module
title: Rest Module | Free Max Stamina Boost | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Running out of stamina in Aniimo? Upgrade the Rest Module on your R V. It raises your max stamina in three steps. Level one gives three percent and comes with the R V. Level two gives six percent and needs R V level three. Level three gives ten percent and needs R V level five, plus fourteen hundred Home Coins. It is a cheap early upgrade that helps every trip. Have you upgraded yours? Comment below!
description: The Rest Module on your Aniimo RV raises max stamina by 3 percent, then 6 percent at RV level 3 and 10 percent at RV level 5 (1,400 Home Coins).
joke: More stamina means more running away from things I could have fought.
